oracle.method: PySCF DF-RHF (neutral) and DF-UHF (doublet ions), default guess

geometry.layout: Na at the origin, halogen on +z
geometry.r_e_source: Huber and Herzberg (1979), NIST Chemistry WebBook

basis.Na: Basis Set Exchange cc-pV{D,T}Z-F12; JKFit def2-universal-JKFIT
basis.halogen_ecp: PySCF cc-pvdz-pp (ECP10MDF for Br, ECP28MDF for I)
